Trace, implement and test: leetcode912 sort an array count sort

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

const int N = 5e4;   
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> sortArray(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<int> dict(2*N + 1, 0); // dict[id]: value -> count
        vector<int> res;
        for (auto& num : nums)
            dict[num + N]++;
        for (int i = 0; i < dict.size(); i++)
        {
            while (dict[i] > 0)
            {
                res.push_back(i - N);
                dict[i]--;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }    
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {5, 1, 3, 1, 2, 3, 3};
    auto res = sol.sortArray(nums);
    for (auto& num : res)
        cout << num << " ";

    return 0;
}
